exploratoryCharters.domain: UI Kit - VcButton, focus ring, DateRangePicker, VcTable, VcScrollbar
exploratoryCharters.mission: Discover where the shared-component rewrites break a consumer rather than the component
candidateScenarios: VcButton sentence-case + icon size: wrapping/truncation at 375px on labels tuned to the old case
Focus ring clipped by an overflow ancestor or hidden behind a sticky bar across checkout
VcTable custom #header with selection enabled: body alignment and select-all
VcScrollbar tab stop follows a runtime prop change

exploratoryCharters.mission: Discover failure modes of the new federated-plugin load path and whether the outage fix holds under it
candidateScenarios: Plugin manifest slow or partially failing: empty state vs unmounted route still in nav
Rep then non-rep in the same tab: stale plugin registration leaking the hub
Deep-link to customer-orders before the plugin registers
Rule-chip state across a period-filter change and browser-back after the VcTabSwitch migration
exploratoryCharters.technique: Galumphing + State Transition; boundary-of-features on load order

exploratoryCharters.mission: Hunt for surfaces that still leak a price when restriction is active
candidateScenarios: Sweep every price-rendering surface in one session from catalog card to CSV export and GraphQL
Distinguish restricted 0.00 from the real no-price-for-currency state
Toggle restriction mid-session against a rendered page and a cached Apollo cart
Price-evaluation troubleshooting tool leaking the price it should hide
exploratoryCharters.lanePrerequisite: playwright-firefox MCP server restarted after the occlusion-pref config change; @playwright/mcp pinned in .mcp.json

exploratoryCharters.mission: Probe the seam where six missions fixes met in one component tree

Dark mode x open-ended mission: status without colour
